notes.title: Player 2 can now rebind their keyboard keys!
notes.content: [p]Hello, detectives![/p][p]Ever get into an argument with a friend about whose finger landed on the wrong key during an important interrogation? Don't worry, we've got a solution![/p][p]We've listened to your feedback and added a new, super-important feature:[/p][list][*][p][b]Player 2 can now rebind their keyboard keys![/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Now you can customize your controls exactly the way you want, so the only thing you have to focus on is solving mysteries—not who accidentally hit the wrong button.[/p][p]Happy sleuthing![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087846/4139e32b14190944d0987fe9c24a26401255d74b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The JerryMaya Detective Agency part of the Back To School Games Celebration 2025
notes.content:
[p]Get ready to sharpen your detective skills! We're excited to announce that [b]The JerryMaya Detective Agency[/b] is part of the [b]Back to School Games Celebration 2025[/b], hosted by [b]LofiGirl[/b] and [b]SpiritCityLofi[/b].[/p][p]Celebrate the start of the school year with a curated selection of games designed to enhance learning and productivity. Discover new gems and enjoy some great discounts. The event runs from August 25th to September 1st.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087846/836db9f28fc128769b71b3727bda553d57b52b78.png"][/img][/p][p]
Whether you're heading back to class or just love a good mystery, we hope you enjoy the celebration! We know Lasse and Maja will. [/p][p]Happy gaming and happy learning![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Added split keyboard co-op mode
notes.content: Now you can play co-op mode with a friend on a single keyboard ⌨️. No need for gamepads 🕹️ .

notes.title: Split Keyboard Option for Local Co-op is Here!
notes.content:
[p align="start"]Thanks so much to all the detective players who shared their feedback with us! We've heard how much you're enjoying the local co-op mode, and we're thrilled to announce a new feature that will make it even easier to team up.

[b]Local Co-op, No Extra Controllers Needed[/b][/p][p align="start"]You can now play co-op mode on a single PC with a [b]split keyboard option[/b]—no need for extra controllers! Now, two players can share one keyboard to investigate together.[/p][p align="start"]Of course, you can still play in co-op mode with external controllers or via Steam Remote Play as well.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087846/6233f492ae9835820708cfb00a94c85c3f7a8327.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Good luck, Detectives![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087846/3c1ef50d1d398b2349ff16c2bc261909b535ef59.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The JerryMaya Detective Agency is Now Available in German!
notes.content:
[p align="start"]Great news, detectives! We're thrilled to announce that [b]The JerryMaya Detective Agency[/b] is now available with full German localization![/p][p align="start"]Our game, based on the beloved book series, has been a huge hit in Sweden and across the Nordics. With the books now finding immense popularity in Germany and so many users asking for a German version, we knew it was the perfect time to bring the adventure to you.[/p][p align="start"]Starting today, you can explore the charming town of Valleby and solve mysteries in your own language. Whether you prefer to play alone or team up with a friend in co-op mode, get ready to put your detective skills to the test and join Jerry and Maya on their most exciting cases yet![/p][p]====
[/p][p]LasseMajas Detektivbüro jetzt auf Deutsch![/p][p align="start"]Großartige Neuigkeiten, Detektivinnen und Detektive! Wir freuen uns riesig, euch mitzuteilen, dass LasseMajas Detektivbüro jetzt auch auf Deutsch verfügbar ist.[/p][p align="start"] Unser Spiel, das auf der beliebten Kinderbuchreihe basiert, war in Schweden und den übrigen nordischen Ländern ein großer Erfolg. Da sich die Bücher auch in Deutschland großer Beliebtheit erfreuen und so viele von euch nach einer deutschsprachigen Version gefragt haben, wussten wir, dass jetzt der perfekte Zeitpunkt gekommen ist, eurem Wunsch nachzukommen.[/p][p align="start"] Ab heute können auch die deutschsprachigen Fans die charmante Stadt Valleby erkunden und knifflige Fälle lösen. Egal, ob ihr lieber allein spielt oder euch im Koop-Modus mit einem Freund zusammenschließt – macht euch bereit, eure Detektivfähigkeiten unter Beweis zu stellen und zusammen mit Lasse und Maja ihre spannendsten Fälle zu lösen![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087846/d612dea078524a0de76133a8b553bd5c21bb132f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Co-op Mode is Here!
notes.content:
[b]Big update! Co-op Mode is Here! 
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087846/af819c2f6f2f6219b7f103234f8aca50c65c9b70.gif[/img]

[u][b]Two Ways to Play:[/b][/u]

[b]• Single Player:[/b] Play as both Jerry and Maya, switching between them to solve mysteries solo.
[b]• Local Co-op:[/b] Team up with a friend! One of you plays as Jerry, and the other plays as Maya. Work together to solve mysteries.

Unleash your inner detective in The JerryMaya Detective Agency, an exciting puzzle platforming adventure for kids and families! Based on the beloved Swedish children’s books, this interactive mystery game invites young detectives to solve crimes, uncover clues, and explore the quirky town of Valleby.

[b]What’s New in the Steam Edition?[/b]

[b]• Local Co-op:[/b] Solve mysteries with a friend for double the fun!
[b]• Enhanced Gameplay:[/b] Play through polished levels full of puzzles and platforming challenges.

Are you ready to crack the case?
Download The JerryMaya Detective Agency – Steam Edition today and start your adventure!
